sn10.4:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling among the Magadhans at the Maṇimālaka Shrine
sn10.4:1.2: Then the yakkha Maṇibhadda approached the Blessed One and in the Blessed One’s presence recited this verse:
sn10.4:2.1: “It is always good for the mindful one
sn10.4:2.2: The mindful one thrives in happiness.
sn10.4:2.3: It is better each day for the mindful one
sn10.4:2.4: And he is freed from enmity.”
sn10.4:3.1: “It is always good for the mindful one
sn10.4:3.2: The mindful one thrives in happiness.
sn10.4:3.3: It is better each day for the mindful one
sn10.4:3.4: But he is not freed from enmity.
sn10.4:4.1: “One whose mind all day and night
sn10.4:4.3: Who has lovingkindness for all beings—
sn10.4:4.4: For him there is enmity with none.”
